name: Twilight
source:
I spent my unchanging, peaceful days with Cyrus, who’s like an elder brother and a parent to me.
If only these days would last forever, that’s what I thought.
Until that windy night, when he appeared.

[Translated from the [url=http://ksrg.sakura.ne.jp/twilight/]official website[/url]]
translation:
我和赛勒斯一起度过了不变的、平静的日子，他对我来说就像是哥哥和父母。
我是这么想的，如果这些日子能够永远持续下去就好了。
直到那个风雨交加的夜晚，他出现了。

[翻译自[url=http://ksrg.sakura.ne.jp/twilight/]官网[/url]]
